Toho Holdings Co., Ltd.
does not publish a restrictive, fixed list of individual third-party manufacturer brands it distributes. Instead, as a major Japanese healthcare and pharmaceutical wholesaler—primarily operating via its core subsidiary
Toho Pharmaceutical
and the Kyoso Mirai Group—it procures and distributes
ethical pharmaceuticals, over-the-counter (OTC) drugs, medical devices, reagents, and medical materials from hundreds of general pharmaceutical and medical equipment manufacturers
to hospitals, clinics, and dispensing pharmacies across Japan.
www.tohohd.co.jp
Core Product & Manufacturer Categories Handled
Ethical (Prescription) Pharmaceuticals:
Sourced from major domestic and international research-based and generic drug manufacturing companies.
MarketScreener India
Generic Pharmaceuticals:
Handled via broad wholesale channels, as well as manufactured internally through its group subsidiary, Kyosomirai Pharma Co., Ltd.
www.tohohd.co.jp
Over-the-Counter (OTC) Products & Reagents:
Procured from various consumer healthcare and chemical product manufacturers for pharmacies and clinical use.
www.tohohd.co.jp
Medical Equipment & Devices:
Sourced from specialized medical technology and hardware manufacturers.
Proprietary Group Brands & Systems
Rather than focusing on external retail brand names, Toho Holdings develops and markets its own proprietary medical support brands and technological infrastructure for hospitals and pharmacies:
Kyoso Mirai Group:
The unified network brand representing the group's dispensing pharmacies and community healthcare provision.
ENIF Series:
Information terminals and ordering systems (
ENIF
ENIFwin
ENI-Pharmacy
) used across medical supply chains.
LXMATE Helios & KAITOS:
Medical care appointment and online medication guidance platforms.
